hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: IR is the hard boundary between graph-derived and LLM-narrated content; cross-cutting failure/empty/truncation reporting is one shared outcome envelope; registry-enumeration gives automatic tool/IPC/MCP parity; both the inline renderer and the D2/Graphviz fallback assemble into the identical single-file shell extending loadMermaidCdnMeta / RenderedArtifactHtml.

boundary.internal: The call-sequence extractor: CALLS-graph traversal from a resolved entry-point symbol, with cycle/recursion detection that guarantees termination and a fixed traversal depth, both encoded only in this extractor's own control flow. Entry-point symbol resolution against the indexed graph. Ordering of call steps within the emitted IR. Private to s3.

api.name: CallGraphReader
api.signature: interface CallGraphReader { revision(repoRoot: string): Promise<string | undefined>; resolveEntryPoint(scope: CallSequenceScope): Promise<CallFrameRef | undefined>; calleesOf(entityId: string): Promise<readonly CallFrameRef[]> }

parameters.name: revision
parameters.purpose: Pinned index revision (undefined when the repo is not 'ready'); same source as s1/s2 readers (listRepos).

parameters.name: resolveEntryPoint
parameters.purpose: Resolve the entry-point symbol to a function/method entity via findEntitiesByName; undefined when not indexed (ac4).

parameters.name: calleesOf
parameters.purpose: 1-hop CALLS successors in recorded edge order via outNeighbors(u64,{kindFilter:['CALLS']}) + entityIdsByU64s; resolved to name+file+startLine (ac1).

returns.meaning: Injected daemon-side read seam; a fake in tests, graph-backed in production (k2). Traversal/cycle/depth logic is NOT in the reader — only raw reads.

preconditions: Bound to the daemon graph layer (k2) or a test fake.
postconditions: Performs only reads; never traverses or mutates.

api.name: buildCallSequenceIR
api.signature: function buildCallSequenceIR(walk: CallWalk, revision: string, scopeDescription: string): DocumentIR

parameters.name: walk
parameters.purpose: The completed bounded-DFS result: ordered frames, ordered steps, per-step cycle-repeat flags, truncated frame ids, depthUsed.

parameters.name: scopeDescription
parameters.purpose: Human-readable label for the IR + rendered title.

returns.meaning: Derived-only IR: one 'call-frame' node per distinct visited entity (label 'name (file:line)', entityId citation); one 'calls' edge per step in visitation order; cycle-repeat steps kept as marked 'calls' edges to the existing frame (ac2); each truncated frame gets a derived 'truncation' marker node stating depthUsed (ac3). narrated.sections=[].

preconditions: Pure: no graph reads; the walk is fully materialized by the DFS in makeExtract.
postconditions: Every node/edge graph-backed with an entityId citation (k11); no fabricated frames.
Cycle-repeat + truncation are DERIVED, not narrated (k8).

api.name: makeExtract
api.signature: function makeExtract(reader: CallGraphReader): (input: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<DocGenOutcome<DocumentIR>>

returns.meaning: Parses scope (repo + symbol + optional maxDepth), resolves the entry point, runs a bounded DFS over calleesOf with a visited set (termination, ac2), materializes the CallWalk, returns ok(buildCallSequenceIR(...)) or a typed sc4 failure.

preconditions: maxDepth defaults to a fixed bound (e.g. 12); the DFS never exceeds it (termination + ac3).
postconditions: Depth-truncation returns ok(IR-with-marker), NOT terminal sc4 'truncated', so the partial doc renders with the truncation stated (ac3); sc4 'truncated' stays available but unused by s3.
Cycles/recursion terminate via the visited set and are shown as repetition (ac2).

api.name: callSequenceRegistration

parameters.name: reader
parameters.purpose: The graph read-seam bound into extract().

returns.meaning: The sc2 registration for docType 'call-sequence': capability + CALL_SEQUENCE_INPUT_SCHEMA (repo + symbol + optional maxDepth) + bound extract().

preconditions: Registered once into docgenRegistry as the 3rd doc type, alongside type-structure (s1) + component-dependency (s2).
postconditions: Enumerable via registry.list() -> automatic tool/IPC/MCP parity (k4).

api.name: documentIRToMermaid

parameters.name: ir
parameters.purpose: The derived IR; dispatch on ir.docType.

returns.meaning: Adds a THIRD dispatch branch: 'call-sequence' -> Mermaid 'sequenceDiagram' (participant per call-frame, A->>B per ordered 'calls' edge, Note over target for cycle-repeat + truncation markers). 'component-dependency' -> flowchart (s2); other -> classDiagram (s1) — both byte-unchanged.

preconditions: Node aliases follow node order; labels escaped.
postconditions: Pure + deterministic; assembleShell reused unchanged (sc3 offline shell). s1/s2 output byte-identical.

dataModelChanges.details: The bounded-DFS output the pure builder consumes: { entry: CallFrameRef; frames: CallFrameRef[]; steps: {from,to,repeat}[] (ordered; repeat=true when 'to' was already on the visited path — ac2); truncatedFrameIds: string[] (cut at maxDepth — ac3); depthUsed: number }. CallFrameRef = { entityId, name, file, startLine }. Private to s3.

s3 populates sc1 with docType 'call-sequence': 'call-frame' nodes + derived 'truncation' marker nodes; 'calls' edges with cycle-repeat steps kept as marked edges to the existing frame. narrated.sections stays empty (k8). No change to the sc1 TYPE — only new kind-string values the open field already permits.

DECISION: s3 uses sc4 'not-found' (ac4), 'source-not-ready', 'empty-scope', and returns ok(IR) even when depth-truncated — depth-truncation is an in-IR derived marker (ac3 requires the partial doc to render). s3 does NOT emit terminal sc4 'truncated'. Non-breaking: no sc4 field added/removed/renamed; the variant stays unused by s3. NO HLD amendment proposed.
callSites: src/docgen/outcome.ts (notFound/sourceNotReady/emptyScope/ok; truncated left unused by s3)

interactionWithShared.howDetails: Derived-only DocumentIR using sc1's listed 'call-frame' node kind + 'calls' edge kind, plus a derived 'truncation' marker node kind (open string field). narrated.sections=[]; generatedAtRevision pinned. No type change.

callSequenceRegistration -> DocTypeRegistration, registered as the 3rd doc type in src/docgen/index.ts; enumerated by the single registry (k4). extractorInputSchema adds symbol + optional maxDepth. No change to sc2.
Renders through assembleShell unchanged; only a new documentIRToMermaid 'sequenceDiagram' branch is added. Same self-contained offline HTML, inlined runtimes, SVG, zoom/pan (k5/k6).

Uses 'not-found' (ac4), 'source-not-ready', 'empty-scope', and 'ok'. Deliberately does NOT use terminal 'truncated' — depth-truncation is shown in-document via a derived IR marker on ok (ac3). No change to sc4.

errorCases.scenario: The chosen entry-point symbol is not present in the indexed code (ac4).
errorCases.detection: reader.resolveEntryPoint(scope) returns undefined because findEntitiesByName yields no 'function'/'method' entity; makeExtract checks if (entry === undefined).
errorCases.response: Return notFound(symbol); no traversal, no IR.
errorCases.userImpact: Told the symbol was not found rather than a fabricated sequence (k11).

errorCases.scenario: The repo is registered but not finished indexing.
errorCases.detection: reader.revision resolves undefined (status !== 'ready'); makeExtract checks if (revision === undefined).

errorCases.scenario: The input lacks a usable repo or entry-point symbol.
errorCases.detection: parseScope finds input['repo'] or input['symbol'] not a non-empty string; makeExtract checks if (scope === undefined).
errorCases.response: Return emptyScope with a 'no repo/symbol' message.

errorCases.scenario: The offline runtime asset is missing from the build output.
errorCases.detection: assembleShell's loadRuntime throws on readFile; caught (shared with s1/s2).
errorCases.response: Return fallbackUnavailable naming copy-assets; never a CDN fetch (k5).
errorCases.userImpact: Actionable build-config error, no view-time network.

errorCases.scenario: A callee u64 has no resolvable entity id (dangling CALLS edge).
errorCases.detection: entityIdsByU64s returns no id for a CALLS neighbor u64, so it is dropped in calleesOf.
errorCases.response: The dangling call is omitted; the calling frame is still emitted.

edgeCases.input: An entry point whose CALLS form a cycle/recursion (ac2).
edgeCases.expected: The visited set stops re-expanding an on-path frame; the repeating call is kept as a repeat=true 'calls' step (Note over target); generation terminates.

edgeCases.input: A call sequence deeper than maxDepth (ac3).
edgeCases.expected: DFS stops at maxDepth; each frame with un-expanded callees is a truncatedFrameId, rendered as a derived 'truncation' marker stating depthUsed, on an ok document.

edgeCases.input: A symbol matching multiple indexed functions/methods.
edgeCases.expected: resolveEntryPoint picks deterministically (stable (file,startLine) order); file:line disambiguates in the header (determinism + ac1).

edgeCases.input: An entry point that calls nothing (leaf).
edgeCases.expected: A valid ok document with one participant and no 'calls' steps — not an error.

edgeCases.input: The same entry point documented twice with no code change.
A frame that calls the same callee twice at the same level.
edgeCases.expected: Two ordered 'calls' steps preserved (sequence multiplicity) — unlike s2's dedupe.

invariantsToPreserve.text: All call-sequence content is derived deterministically from the indexed CALLS graph; the LLM is never in this path (narrated.sections stays empty).
Graph reads happen inside the daemon via the injected reader; the DFS/build performs no I/O beyond reader calls (k2).
Every frame and call is graph-backed with an entityId citation — no raw dump, no invented frame; unresolved targets are dropped (k11).

alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Bounded DFS over CALLS from the resolved entry point; render as a Mermaid sequenceDiagram; cycle-repetition and depth-truncation are DERIVED marker nodes/edges inside the ok IR; sc4 not-found for a missing entry point.

alternativesConsidered.name: Depth-limited DFS + reuse s2's flowchart call-tree + in-IR markers

alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Only PARTIAL on ac1 (a flowchart loses call ORDER, which ac1 requires) and ac2 (a cycle reads as an ordinary back-edge, weakening 'shown as such'). k3 (accuracy over cost) tips against the small shell saving.

alternativesConsidered.name: Literal sc4 terminal outcomes for truncation (no in-IR marker)

alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Violates ac3 (the terminal 'truncated' carries no shell -> NO document on truncation) and ac2 (silent cycle collapse hides repetition). Contract-literal but requirement-breaking.
